intro: Two popia goreng have an estimated 200 kcal. Most of the calories come from the popia skin and frying oil.

variants.name: Popia goreng with chicken / beef filling

diet: Yes, if you watch how many. Two rolls are still okay as a snack. The problem is mini popia are easy to eat by the dozen during buka puasa or at events. Count how many before you start eating.
tips: Take 2 rolls and put them on a plate. Don't eat straight from the container.
Pick popia basah if available, because it's not fried.
At home, use an air fryer and add more vegetables to the filling.

swap.name: Popia basah, 1 roll
swap.why: Same vegetable filling but not fried, so less oil.

faq.q: What's the usual popia goreng filling?
faq.a: Sengkuang, carrot, taugeh and sometimes dried prawns or minced chicken.

faq.q: How do I stop popia goreng from being oily?
faq.a: Make sure the filling is dry and the oil is hot. Drain on a rack or kitchen towel after frying.
Yes, freeze them before frying. Fry straight from frozen, no need to thaw.
